# controld_service (Resource)

Manages the action applied to a built-in ControlD service (e.g. a streaming or social media service) for a profile. Services are predefined by ControlD (see the `controld_services` data source for the full catalog); deleting this resource restores the service to its default state (bypass, disabled).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_service" "netflix" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  service    = "netflix"
  do         = 1 # bypass
  status     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `do` (Number) The action to take: `0` (block), `1` (bypass), `2` (spoof), or `3` (redirect).
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile this service action belongs to.
- `service` (String) The service identifier (PK), as returned by the `controld_services` data source.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the service action is enabled.

### Optional

- `via` (String) The destination IP/hostname used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`.
- `via_v6` (String) The IPv6 destination used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource, in the form `profile_id/service`.
